catalogEmpty.clearToSeeAll: Clear filters or search to see everything.
catalogEmpty.entityHint: Details appear here after you add videos and fill in their metadata.
catalogEmpty.javNoMetadata: Scanned videos without release metadata are listed under All content.
catalogEmpty.onlineCreatorsHint: Add follow sources and fetch content to see their creators here.
catalogEmpty.onlineHint: Add follow sources and fetch content to see their metadata here.
catalogEmpty.onlineTagsHint: Add follow sources and fetch content to see their tags here.
catalogEmpty.startCollection: Add a media directory or follow a source to start your collection.

gettingStarted.connectDirectoriesHint: Check your media directories, the library each belongs to, and their read policy.
gettingStarted.downloadsHint: Connect download channels, set target directories, and pair the userscript if needed.
gettingStarted.emptyCollection: Your collection is empty. Check whether the scan has started.
gettingStarted.followCheck: You follow some sources. Check their required credentials.
gettingStarted.followEmpty: Follow creators and sources you want to keep up with.
gettingStarted.followReady: Required credentials for enabled sources are in place.
gettingStarted.historyEmpty: Import browsing history or bookmarks if you like.
gettingStarted.historyImported_one: Browsing history imported from {{count, number}} source.
gettingStarted.historyImported_other: Browsing history imported from {{count, number}} sources.
gettingStarted.importedCount_one: {{count, number}} video imported. See progress in Tasks.
gettingStarted.importedCount_other: {{count, number}} videos imported. See progress in Tasks.
gettingStarted.openCollectionHint: Search and browse imported videos from Home.
gettingStarted.phoneAccessHint: Check who can connect, the address, and the password.
gettingStarted.statusError: Couldn't load setup status. Retry, or open the pages directly.
gettingStarted.summary: Connect media directories, check what was imported, then open your collection.
gettingStarted.title: Start your collection

guideAppMaintenance.autoCheckBody: Regularly checks whether a new version is available.
guideAppMaintenance.autoDownloadBody: Downloads updates as soon as they're found; installing still waits for your confirmation.
guideAppMaintenance.autoUpdatesBody: Choose automatic checks, automatic downloads, and check frequency. After a download finishes, confirm the restart to install when prompted.
guideAppMaintenance.backupsBody: Back up the current database now, or restore from a backup in the list. Restoring replaces the current database after saving a copy of it; only the primary computer can restore.
guideAppMaintenance.checkFrequencyBody: Sets how often to check for new versions.
guideAppMaintenance.cleanupBody: Removes generated files or old backups within the confirmed scope; check the list before running it.
guideAppMaintenance.cleanupTitle: Clean up cache and old backups
guideAppMaintenance.desktopShortcutBody: Adds a desktop shortcut for opening Peach.
guideAppMaintenance.detailsUploadBody: Controls uploading collection and taste info separately; review the current upload preview and confirm before turning it on.
guideAppMaintenance.diagnosticsUploadBody: Uploads version, system info, failure type, code location, and occurrence count.
guideAppMaintenance.diagnosticsUploadTitle: Send version stats and error diagnostics
guideAppMaintenance.factsBody: Runtime info helps check the environment. You can reopen the guided tour any time; your progress is stored in the database on the computer running Peach and shared across all devices.
guideAppMaintenance.launchAtStartupBody: Starts the app after you sign in to the system; availability depends on the platform.
guideAppMaintenance.moveDataBody: Changes where metadata and cache are stored; follow the steps to move them and restart. Media directories are set separately.
guideAppMaintenance.reportingBody: Version stats and error diagnostics, and collection and taste details, are separate choices. You can preview details before they're uploaded; turn them on only if you want to.
guideAppMaintenance.startupBody: Set launch at startup, tray only, and a desktop shortcut. Available options vary by platform.
guideAppMaintenance.storageBody: See what's using space and clean up cache and old backups as needed. Moving the data directory moves metadata and cache; media directories are managed separately.
guideAppMaintenance.summary: Updates, storage, data choices, and app maintenance.
guideAppMaintenance.transcodeBody: Playback transcoding sets how videos are processed for compatible playback; frame decoding is set separately in Settings > Library.
guideAppMaintenance.trayOnlyBody: Keeps running in the background at startup; open the page when you need it.
guideAppMaintenance.trayOnlyTitle: Start only the tray, without opening the web app
guideAppMaintenance.uninstallBody: Uninstalling removes the program; a full uninstall also removes settings, metadata, history, credentials, and cache. Before running it, check the data directory and details listed on the page.
guideAppMaintenance.updatesBody: Checks for available versions. Downloading and restarting to install are separate steps; follow the status on the page.
guideAppMaintenance.uploadPreviewBody: See what this upload would include before deciding whether to turn on detail uploads.
guideAppMaintenance.usageBody: See how much space metadata, cache, and backups take up.

guideAppearance.contrastBody: Turn on for clearer separation between text and background.
guideAppearance.glowBody: Controls the sidebar background glow. When it's on, pick a color preset or adjust colors and settings one by one; Glass original shows only the settings that apply.
guideAppearance.glowColorsBody: Set each of the three glow colors to create your own palette.
guideAppearance.glowDriftBody: Controls how fast the background glow moves.
guideAppearance.glowGrainBody: Controls the grain in the glow texture; lower it for a smoother background.
guideAppearance.glowIntensityBody: Controls how bright the glow is; lower it if it's distracting.
guideAppearance.glowPresetsBody: Applies a set of colors and settings at once; a good way to pick the overall look first.
guideAppearance.glowResetBody: Resets the glow colors and settings to their defaults.
guideAppearance.glowSizeBody: Controls how much area the glow covers.
guideAppearance.glowSoftnessBody: Controls how soft the glow's edges are.
guideAppearance.sidebarBody: Put the items you use most in the sidebar and drag to reorder them.
guideAppearance.soundsBody: Controls feedback sounds for interface actions; choose what suits your surroundings.
guideAppearance.themeBody: Choose light, dark, or match the system, to suit different lighting.

guideBasics.cardsBody: Select a video to see its metadata, editions, and ways to play it. If the first scan hasn't imported anything yet, continue with the navigation steps for now.
guideBasics.navigationBody: Browse by people, studios, and tags in the sidebar. On a phone, tap the navigation button to open the sidebar. You can change which items appear and their order in Preferences.
guideBasics.preferencesBody: Preferences at the bottom of the sidebar hold display and playback options; on a phone, open the sidebar first. Media directories, network, and background services are under Settings there.
guideBasics.searchBody: Enter a title, code, performer, label, or tag. Results come from videos already imported.
guideBasics.summary: Four steps covering search, navigation, video details, and preferences.
guideBasics.title: Get to know the interface

guideContent.sfwBody: Hides sensitive images and stops hover previews, for places where the screen needs to stay covered. For access control, set an access password instead.
guideContent.summary: SFW mode and what's shown on screen.

guideDevices.addressBody: Devices on the same LAN use Peach's LAN address. When access is limited to the computer running Peach, other devices can't connect.
guideDevices.passwordBody: Devices that can reach Peach sign in with the access password. Display preferences and access permissions are separate settings.
guideDevices.summary: Addresses, password, LAN, and remote access.
guideDevices.title: Phones and other devices
guideDevices.tunnelBody: Cloudflare remote access lets you reach Peach away from your LAN; set up the connection details to match your deployment.
guideDevices.tunnelTitle: Turn on remote access if needed

guideDiagnostics.attentionBody: Open an item that needs attention to see the cause and how to recover; with no issues, view collection health.
guideDiagnostics.reportBody: After fixing the cause, you can check again. If you need to share troubleshooting info, download the diagnostics report yourself.
guideDiagnostics.sessionsBody: Shows each source's session status, failure reasons, and last successful parse, to help diagnose connection and metadata problems.
guideDiagnostics.summary: Checks and diagnostics reports for when something goes wrong.
guideDiagnostics.systemChecksBody: Expand other checks to see current status grouped by system, configuration, and more. Checks that need attention are listed separately at the top of the page.

guideDirectory.interfaceSummary_one: Learn the main entry points in {{count, number}} step. Explore the rest when you need it.
guideDirectory.interfaceSummary_other: Learn the main entry points in {{count, number}} steps. Explore the rest when you need it.
guideDirectory.noMatchesHint: Try a feature or setting name.
guideDirectory.searchSettings: Search by setting name or purpose
guideDirectory.settingsSummary: Start with appearance and navigation. Check other settings as needed.

guideDownloads.browserBody: Install the userscript and pair it with Peach. The default channel decides where items are sent; the Enable switch turns the feature on or off, the dedicated token can be renewed or turned off, and script detection helps confirm pairing.
guideDownloads.cloudDriveBody: The address locates the service; the token authorizes Peach to call its API.
guideDownloads.defaultChannelBody: Sets the download channel used by default when adding from the browser.
guideDownloads.downloadBody: The CloudDrive2 address and API token connect to the service; you can find it automatically or check the connection. The 115 and PikPak target directories set where files go in the cloud, the local media directory mapping lets downloads be imported, and the wait limit sets how long to wait.
guideDownloads.enableBody: Controls whether adding from the browser accepts requests.
guideDownloads.findCheckBody: Finds a reachable service or checks the current connection.
guideDownloads.mediaMappingBody: Maps cloud targets to mount paths Peach can scan, so downloads can be imported.
guideDownloads.pairingBody: Confirms the userscript is installed and connected to this Peach server.
guideDownloads.pikpakBody: Choose account and password or browser sign-in on the page; the connection status shows whether it's usable. You start the sign-in yourself.
guideDownloads.summary: Cloud download directories, accounts, and browser pairing.
guideDownloads.target115Body: Sets which cloud directory stores items sent to 115.
guideDownloads.targetPikpakBody: Sets which cloud directory stores items sent to PikPak.
guideDownloads.tokenBody: Authorizes the userscript to connect. After renewing it, pair again; turning it off stops the feature.
guideDownloads.waitLimitBody: Sets the longest time to wait for download results.

guideEntities.manageTagsBody: The pencil button opens tag management, where you can organize tag names and relationships; click it again to return to browsing.
guideEntities.peopleBody: Select a person's card to open their profile, with related videos, photos, and linked sources. Use the switcher at the top for performers, sellers, and online people.
guideEntities.studiosBody: Select a studio card to see its videos together. Videos on its profile page are still limited to the current library.
guideEntities.summary: Discover related videos in your collection through people, studios, and tags.
guideEntities.tagsBody: Select a tag to browse related videos. Local and online videos use different tag vocabularies.
guideEntities.title: Browse by people and topics

guideEntry.filterHint: More filters, such as source and duration, are in the sidebar.
guideEntry.filterSort: Filter and sort above the list
guideEntry.navButton: Navigation button at the top left
guideEntry.playerHint: Once playback starts, choose subtitles and playback options in the player.
guideEntry.playlistsHint: If Playlists isn't in the sidebar, add it in Preferences → Appearance → Navigation items. On a phone, open the sidebar first.
guideEntry.searchHint: On a phone, tap the magnifier first, then type your search.
guideEntry.sidebarHint: If the sidebar is collapsed, click the navigation button at the top left first.
guideEntry.sidebarPreferences: Preferences at the bottom of the sidebar

guideExternal.browserBody: After pairing the userscript with Peach, you can add videos from the browser. Manage the dedicated token, default channel, and on/off switch in Settings > Downloads.
guideExternal.downloadsBody: Connect a supported channel, then set the cloud target directory and the local media directory. Finished downloads are imported by directory rules.
guideExternal.searchBody: Torrent search uses your configured indexers. When results come back, you still choose what to download.
guideExternal.summary: Cloud download, directory mapping, and adding from the browser.
guideExternal.title: Add videos from outside

guideFindPlay.detailBody: This shows the current video's title and source file tools. Rating, people, and tags are below; for videos with parts or editions, open the matching queue from the collection card.
guideFindPlay.externalBody: Choose a local player, an M3U playlist, or a stream URL here, then click Open. Another device must be able to reach the current Peach address.
guideFindPlay.filterBody: Filters combine to narrow the results. If you can't find something, check the selected library and filters first.
guideFindPlay.libraryBody: Switch between all libraries or a single library at the top of the navigation; on a phone, open the sidebar first. A library groups several directories together.
guideFindPlay.playerBody: The bottom control bar has play, progress, volume, and full screen. The gear on the right opens playback speed, subtitles, rotation, quality, and more.
guideFindPlay.searchBody: Enter a title, code, or name, then narrow the results with filters and sorting. Set how many searches to keep in Preferences > Search.
guideFindPlay.subtitlesBody: Open Subtitles from the player's gear menu to pick an existing subtitle, load a local subtitle file, or search for subtitles. Playback speed and quality are in the same menu.
guideFindPlay.summary: Search, filters, details, editions, subtitles, and the player.
guideFindPlay.title: Find and play

guideFollow.credentialsBody: Some sources need sign-in credentials. Decide which sources to enable first, then expand the matching site and fill in what it asks for.
guideFollow.feedBody: Creator updates from different sources come together here; select one to view it. If you don't follow any sources yet, add one from the empty state.
guideFollow.sourcesBody: The list shows each source's status, fetch results, and failure reasons; switch to the Add section to add creators or subscriptions.
guideFollow.summary: Updates from multiple sources, merging the same video, and source status.

guideInsights.historyBody: History sources you've added are listed here. You can stop reading local browsers or remove imported sources; the tour doesn't change these records.
guideInsights.importBody: Reading browser history must be done on the computer running Peach; on other devices, use the More options menu to import history or bookmark files.
guideInsights.statsBody: Pick a stats view to see your collection, storage, and watch activity; links in each view lead to the related videos.
guideInsights.summary: Stats, taste, and browsing history and bookmark sources.
guideInsights.tasteBody: Switch between browser history and your Peach watches and ratings here to analyze the taste in each.
guideInsights.title: Know your collection

guideJav.libraryBody: Find imported videos by code, performers, and label, and choose official covers or preview images.
guideJav.newBody: Discover recommends videos based on your taste. Switch between your collection and external videos here, and filter by tag.
guideJav.qualityBody: Upgrade cards list the current edition's details and why it was flagged; you can view editions or search torrents. With no targets, this shows an empty state.
guideJav.summary: Collection, new releases, want list, and HD upgrades.
guideJav.title: JAV and new releases
guideJav.wantsBody: Add external videos you like to your want list; switch between Collection, Discover, and Want here.

guideJavSettings.compilationsBody: Hides large compilations from new releases. This only affects new releases; you can still find them in your collection.
guideJavSettings.excerptsBody: Hides clips from new releases. This only affects new releases; you can still find them in your collection.
guideJavSettings.imageBody: Choose official covers or preview images as the default image on cards.
guideJavSettings.limitBody: Controls how many new releases the section shows at a time.
guideJavSettings.scrollBody: Controls whether the new releases section scrolls automatically.
guideJavSettings.soloCompilationsBody: Hides single-actress compilations from new releases. This only affects new releases; you can still find them in your collection.

guideLibrary.apiProxyBody: Controls the connection used for requests to the CloudDrive API.
guideLibrary.autoImportBody: Lets detected changes trigger imports; when it's off, scan manually as needed.
guideLibrary.cloudDriveNotifyBody: CloudDrive2 pushes directory changes to Peach.
guideLibrary.cloudProxyBody: The data proxy handles file content requests and the API proxy handles API requests. Choose the mode, address, and port for each, and enter a username and password if authentication is required; both are set separately from the Peach proxy.
guideLibrary.codeRulesBody: Follow the format in the input box; rules extract codes from file names. Check the rules against the target file names before saving.
guideLibrary.codesBody: When a file name can't be recognized, check or add recognition rules. Rules affect future recognition, so check the examples first.
guideLibrary.dataProxyBody: Controls the connection used to read file content.
guideLibrary.directoryChangeBody: When changing a saved directory path, choose to relocate the original directory or add another one.
guideLibrary.directoryLibraryBody: A directory is where media is actually stored; several directories can belong to the same library.
guideLibrary.discoveryBody: Monitor local directories or receive CloudDrive2 notifications. The webhook receives events, and path mapping maps notification paths to media directories.
guideLibrary.foldersBody: Enter the media directory path and choose its storage. When changing a saved path, follow the prompt to relocate the original directory or add another one; with several libraries, you can move a directory to another library.
guideLibrary.frameDecodingBody: Choose the decoder used to generate previews; playback transcoding is set separately.
guideLibrary.generatePreviewsBody: Controls generating contact sheets and preview cache; reads also follow the library rules.
guideLibrary.identityBody: Helps tell content apart in the sidebar and on cards; the name doesn't change file paths.
guideLibrary.mediaBody: The name, icon, and color tell libraries apart. A library can contain several directories; the directory rows below set local or cloud drive mount paths.
guideLibrary.monitorLocalBody: Receives file system changes on the computer running Peach to find new content.
guideLibrary.mountsBody: Saved directories show their mount status next to the path; new directories may have none until saved. If a cloud drive mount is unavailable, restore it before scanning.
guideLibrary.pathMappingBody: Translates paths in source notifications into media directory paths Peach can access.
guideLibrary.policyAutoBody: Reads local metadata and fills in missing metadata, covers, and people photos online; local videos can get contact sheet previews.
guideLibrary.policyBody: Choose how the whole library is processed here. Custom lets you pick probing, metadata, covers, people, and previews separately.
guideLibrary.policyCustomBody: Choose each step separately: probe duration and resolution, fill in video metadata, get covers, fill in people metadata, and generate previews.
guideLibrary.policyLocalBody: Uses local NFO files and images, and reads video info under the read policy; local videos can get contact sheet previews.
guideLibrary.previewBody: Generating previews reads videos and creates cache, and also follows the library's processing and read policy. The seek preview switch and interval control thumbnails for videos on local disks; frame decoding sets which decoder previews use.
guideLibrary.proxyAuthBody: Fill in only if the proxy requires authentication.
guideLibrary.proxyModeBody: The mode sets how to connect; custom mode needs a valid proxy address and port.
guideLibrary.readDataSaverBody: Limits automatic video reads; suits mounts where reading uses metered data.
guideLibrary.readPolicyBody: Each directory has its own read policy. Standard allows reading videos under the processing rules; Data saver suits metered mounts and limits automatic video reads.
guideLibrary.readStandardBody: Allows reading video info and generating previews under the processing rules; suits local disks or unmetered mounts.
guideLibrary.seekPreviewBody: Shows thumbnails on the playback timeline for videos on local disks.
guideLibrary.storageBody: Whether the directory is on a local disk or a cloud drive mount, used to choose suitable read behavior.
guideLibrary.thumbnailIntervalBody: Sets the time between neighboring timeline thumbnails; a shorter interval creates more cache.
guideLibrary.webhookBody: An endpoint where source services send change events.

guideMaintenance.organizeBody: File organizing shows a preview first; confirm the naming and target directory before running it. Organizing metadata and changing actual files have different scopes.
guideMaintenance.reviewBody: Find items to review by category first, then check each item's sources and evidence before deciding.
guideMaintenance.scanBody: In the library processing section, choose what to scan and which metadata to process. Read policies come from library settings; the tour won't start any tasks.
guideMaintenance.summary: Scanning, metadata, review, file organizing, and trash.
guideMaintenance.tasksBody: Task history shows processing status; expand an entry for details and failure reasons. With no tasks yet, this explains which actions leave a record.
guideMaintenance.title: Organize and maintain
guideMaintenance.trashBody: Shows videos moved to the trash; restore or handle them as needed. Before deleting permanently, check the scope in the confirmation dialog carefully.

guideNetwork.accessBody: Set or change the password for entering Peach; when it's off, any device that can reach Peach gets in directly.
guideNetwork.connectionStatusBody: Shows whether remote access is reachable yet.
guideNetwork.currentPasswordBody: Verifies your current password when you change it.
guideNetwork.customProxyBody: Sets the proxy Peach uses; leave it blank to keep the saved address.
guideNetwork.hostnameBody: Enter the domain for the named tunnel.
guideNetwork.namedTunnelBody: Connects to a configured, fixed remote access address.
guideNetwork.newPasswordBody: Enter the same password twice; after saving, sign in with the new password.
guideNetwork.passwordOffBody: After saving, any device that can reach Peach gets in directly.
guideNetwork.portBody: See the addresses available on the computer running Peach, on the LAN, and from other devices. You can leave the port as is; after saving a port change, use the new address shown on the page.
guideNetwork.proxyBody: Sources can connect through the system proxy, directly, or through a custom proxy address. If connections fail, check the current mode and address first.
guideNetwork.summary: Port, proxy, password, and remote access.
guideNetwork.systemProxyBody: Uses the proxy settings of the computer running Peach.
guideNetwork.tunnelBody: A quick tunnel gives a temporary connection; a named tunnel uses a hostname and tunnel token. Connection status shows whether it's ready; turn it on as needed.
guideNetwork.tunnelTokenBody: Authorizes the computer running Peach to connect to the named tunnel.

guidePlayback.autoplayBody: Decides whether video details start playing right away. Turn it off for quiet browsing.
guidePlayback.batchBody: Sets how many items a list loads at a time. Lower it if lists are slow.
guidePlayback.hoverBody: How long the pointer rests before a preview starts, in seconds. Increase it if previews start by accident.
guidePlayback.miniplayerBody: Keeps playing in a mini player when you leave details; turn it off to focus on browsing.
guidePlayback.seekBody: Sets how many seconds each skip jumps; adjust it to how you watch.
guidePlayback.sizeBody: Large cards show covers better; compact view shows more videos at once.
guidePlayback.sortBody: Decides what you see first when you open a list; random order has no ascending or descending.
guidePlayback.summary: List display, hover previews, and playback behavior.
guidePlayback.versionsBody: Shows the parts and editions of the same video together; choose one in details when playing.

guidePopover.entryMissing: This entry isn't shown on this page. It may have no content yet, need permission, or still be loading. Skip and come back later.
guidePopover.noDemoVideo: No video or control to demo yet. Add videos first, or skip and come back later.

guideSave.listsBody: Enter a name here to create a playlist. Then add videos with the Add to playlist button in video details.
guideSave.markActionsBody: Likes shape taste recommendations, Watch later makes videos easy to find again, and Add to playlist organizes videos into your own playlists.
guideSave.marksBody: Click the stars to rate a video. Like, Watch later, and Add to playlist below save the videos you're interested in.
guideSave.queueBody: Select a playlist card to open its queue, where you can review and reorder playback. If you have no playlists, create one and add videos first.
guideSave.summary: Ratings, marks, playlists, and the current play queue.
guideSave.title: Save what you like

guideScopes.perOption: Each option takes effect when you save or confirm it on the page
guideScopes.readOnlyChecks: Read-only checks · You start rechecks and downloads
guideScopes.serverConfirm: Computer running Peach · Saved after you confirm

guideSearchSettings.historyBody: Sets how many searches to keep; 0 turns search history off.
guideSearchSettings.relatedBody: Decides how many related recommendations appear in details. Manage taste and history sources on the Taste page.
guideSearchSettings.summary: Search history, recommendation count, and taste.

guideSubscriptions.apiKeyBody: Authorizes Peach to use the indexer; fill in what the indexer provides.
guideSubscriptions.autoCheckBody: Decides whether to check enabled sources for new content regularly; saves automatically.
guideSubscriptions.checkIntervalBody: Sets the time between regular checks; saves automatically.
guideSubscriptions.credentialsBody: Expand the sites you use and fill in the sign-in details each requires. Leave saved fields blank to keep them; changes take effect with each site form's Save button.
guideSubscriptions.entryLinksBody: Configure metadata sites and mirrors used to open related video pages. Addresses and sign-in credentials are managed separately.
guideSubscriptions.feedFetchBody: Controls fetching subscription content; the page shows the actual status and actions.
guideSubscriptions.followOptionsBody: The initial fetch range sets how far back to look. Automatic update checks and their interval control later checks; see the page for subscription fetching and avatar and favicon refresh info.
guideSubscriptions.iconRefreshBody: The page shows existing refresh info; avatars identify creators and favicons identify sites.
guideSubscriptions.indexersBody: Enter a name, Torznab URL, and API key for each indexer, and add or remove sources. Torrent search gives candidate results; you confirm downloads separately.
guideSubscriptions.initialRangeBody: Sets how far back newly added follow sources look; saved with the collection.
guideSubscriptions.sourcesBody: See where video metadata comes from and its sign-in status here. Credentials for follows are managed separately below; enable sources as needed.
guideSubscriptions.summary: Metadata sources, follows, indexers, and site links.
guideSubscriptions.torznabUrlBody: The query API URL the indexer provides.

guideTopics.browseSummary: Search and play, people and tags, JAV new releases
guideTopics.collectSummary: Marks and playlists, creator updates, taste and stats
guideTopics.discoverySummary: Search and recommendations, new releases, follow sources
guideTopics.experienceSummary: Interface style, playback behavior, content display
guideTopics.storageSummary: Libraries, directories, reading, and download channels
guideTopics.systemSummary: Network access, app maintenance, system diagnostics
guideTopics.watchSummary: Video wall, immersive viewing, phone access

guideViewing.immerseBody: Immersive mode is for continuous viewing. Clicking it starts playback, so use it when you're ready to watch.
guideViewing.miniBody: With the mini player on, playback continues after you leave details. Autoplay, the mini player, and the seek step are in Preferences > Playback.
guideViewing.summary: Video wall, immersive mode, and the details mini player.
guideViewing.title: Focused viewing
guideViewing.wallBody: The video wall shows several videos at once. After the tour, click it and choose what to play.

tutorialCenter.chapterDone: Tour complete. Explore other features when you need them.
tutorialCenter.chapterIncomplete: Chapter ended. Steps that weren't shown are still unfinished; you can continue later.
tutorialCenter.closeDialogFirst: Close the open details or dialog before starting a tour.
tutorialCenter.closeMiniPlayer: Close the mini player before starting the player tour.
tutorialCenter.completionNotSaved: Tour ended, but completion wasn't saved. Reload tour progress and try again.
tutorialCenter.inviteBody: Click the compass for a {{count, number}}-step intro to Peach. Explore the rest when you need it.
tutorialCenter.inviteError: Couldn't load the tour tip. Reload to try again.
tutorialCenter.loadError: Couldn't load tour progress. Reload to try again.
tutorialCenter.quickTourDone: Quick tour complete. The tour button is now hidden on all devices; reopen it from Preferences → Settings → Maintenance → Guided tour.
tutorialCenter.reloadFirst: Reload tour progress before starting a tour.
tutorialCenter.saveError: Couldn't save tour progress, so other devices won't see it. Reload to continue.
tutorialCenter.title: Guided tour
tutorialCenter.tourLoadError: Couldn't load the tour. Try again.
tutorialCenter.unsavedForm: This form has unsaved changes. Save or discard them before opening another page.
tutorialCenter.unsavedFormChapter: This form has unsaved changes. Save or discard them before starting a chapter that switches pages.
